All 47 protected objects remain exact. Zero private path values require zero omissions. These are recorded transaction and preservation checks, not proof of cognitive independence or retrospective source completeness.

Attachment and value remain unestablished. These are separate from zero source-tag, locator, timing, mechanical, strict-replay, span, geometry-arithmetic and schema errors.

Together with the two modifier omissions these affect four distinct positions. Dated current-only observations cover the four positions without rewriting frozen originals or forcing canonical substitutions.

Empty selected-resolved mark arrays alone are not defects where exact masks, uncertainty ledgers and source preflight jointly preserve inspected alternatives. They are not eight physical dates or authenticated chronology. Physical totals remain null where unresolved.

Address sides 331, 333 and 334 show no additional continuous encoded group. Isolated pink/red marks on 333 and grey/greenish marks on 334 remain unclassified, with material, authorship, cipher role and numeral value unestablished. Earlier 310/320/321/327/329 qualifications remain unchanged.

Only queue objects 331–334 change; the other 259 and all prior 81 address objects remain exact. Catalogue picture_urls/address_urls arrays remain exact. Only queue332 gains selected_source with Address side and the actual address URL; source_sha256 binds that same address source. No aliases or ordinary address redistribution.
